paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the time cost distribution before and after the implementation of efficient deployment methods, with two distinct segments: "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment." The "Reduction" segment, represented in orange, accounts for 69.92% of the total time cost, corresponding to 60.9 seconds. The "Efficient deployment" segment, shown in blue, represents 30.08% of the total time cost, equivalent to 26.2 seconds. The chart visually emphasizes the significant reduction in time cost, with the "Reduction" slice being substantially larger than the "Efficient deployment" slice. The total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1 seconds (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after implementation. The chart includes percentage labels within each slice and a legend to identify the segments.
